description: This source file defines the CompareCondition class, which implements the handling of the <if-compare> element in the OFBiz mini-language. It contains logic for comparing fields based on specified operators and types, and for executing sub-operations based on the comparison result.

classes.name: CompareCondition
classes.description: Implements the <if-compare> element, performing comparison logic and conditional execution of sub-operations.

classes.name: CompareCondition.CompareConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of CompareCondition from XML elements.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the comparison based on the configured operator, type, and field value, returning true if the condition holds.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes sub-operations if the condition is true, or else sub-operations if the condition is false.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information from nested sub-operations.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Creates a string representation of the comparison for debugging or logging.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns an XML-like string representation of the <if-compare> element with current attributes.
